newsitem.title: INDIA: India rupee eases as corporate dlr demand picks up.
newsitem.headline: India rupee eases as corporate dlr demand picks up.

text.p: The Indian rupee eased to a low of 35.627/637 per dollar on Monday afternoon trade, down from the day's opening quote of 35.60/61, dealers said.
They said month-end demand for dollars appeared to have picked up at last as a leading state-run bank was in the market buying dollars up 35.6350 level.
Earlier in the day, the Reserve Bank of India bought dollars at 35.6250 level, dealers said.
"Maybe it's month-end demand," said a dealer at a brokerage. "The market is slightly short (on dollars) from morning."
